rubrics.justification: Generally recognizes a good-quality blastocyst and comments on ICM/TE, but overstates confidence from a single image, is somewhat inconsistent on expansion stage, and infers AA-level features that are not crisply demonstrable in this image.
Thoroughly integrates age, BMI, ovarian reserve markers, diagnosis, semen parameters, cycle history, and endometrium with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly consistent, with a plausible probability estimate tied to embryo quality and patient factors; minor tension exists around calling the embryo both strong and not elite, and around stage 3 vs expanded terminology.

Largely consistent with IVF practice and evidence-based counseling, including avoiding overtesting after a first failure; minor deviations include somewhat overemphasizing evaluation of a 15 mm lining and some looseness around Gardner staging terminology.

Provides practical next steps for transfer, luteal support, cavity review, lifestyle optimization, and future-cycle considerations; useful though some recommendations remain somewhat general rather than protocol-specific.
